dialogues.speaker: Vikhrov
dialogues.text: Hmm... Where did I put it...?

dialogues.speaker: Vikhrov
dialogues.text: Ah! S-sorry. Hello. It's not important, really.

dialogues.speaker: Vikhrov
dialogues.text: Just a few notes... routes, maps, things like that...

dialogues.speaker: Vikhrov
dialogues.text: This is my first time in Snezhnograd, so I'm not exactly sure where I'm going... But it's fine. I-I don't want to trouble you.

dialogues.speaker: Vikhrov
dialogues.text: Th-thank you. I'll do my best...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could ask the staff if you need help.

dialogues.speaker: Vikhrov
dialogues.text: Ah, no, it's okay... I'll manage.

dialogues.speaker: Vikhrov
dialogues.text: The staff here must be busy... If I ask about something this trivial, they might laugh at me...

dialogues.speaker: Vikhrov
dialogues.text: Father told me Snezhnograd would be nothing like home. He said I had to be careful here, or people would start looking down on me... So maybe I shouldn't trouble anyone.
